alias: Ventilate bedroom when CO2 is high
rule:
id: L2_r01
alias: Ventilate bedroom when CO2 is high
trigger:
- platform: numeric_state
  entity_id: sensor.bedroom_co2
  above: 1000
action:
- service: cover.open_cover
  target:
    entity_id: cover.bedroom_window
effects_to_choose_from: air_exchange:increase indoor_temperature:decrease indoor_temperature:increase passage_opening:increase sound:increase visibility:increase

alias: Unlock front door when smoke is detected
rule:
id: L2_r02
alias: Unlock front door when smoke is detected
trigger:
- platform: state
  entity_id: binary_sensor.kitchen_smoke
  to: 'on'
action:
- service: lock.unlock
  target:
    entity_id: lock.front_door

id: L2_r03
alias: Open living window on smoke
trigger:
- platform: state
  entity_id: binary_sensor.kitchen_smoke
  to: 'on'
action:
- service: cover.open_cover
  target:
    entity_id: cover.living_window
effects_to_choose_from: air_exchange:increase indoor_temperature:decrease indoor_temperature:increase passage_opening:increase sound:increase visibility:increase

rule:
id: L2_r04
alias: Shut water main on leak
trigger:
- platform: state
  entity_id: binary_sensor.bathroom_leak
  to: 'on'
action:
- service: valve.close_valve
  target:
    entity_id: valve.water_main

alias: Cool bedroom through the window when hot inside
rule:
id: L2_r05
alias: Cool bedroom through the window when hot inside
trigger:
- platform: numeric_state
  entity_id: sensor.bedroom_temperature
  above: 28
action:
- service: cover.open_cover
  target:
    entity_id: cover.bedroom_window
effects_to_choose_from: air_exchange:increase indoor_temperature:decrease indoor_temperature:increase passage_opening:increase sound:increase visibility:increase

rule:
id: L2_r06
alias: Bathroom exhaust on humidity
trigger:
- platform: numeric_state
  entity_id: sensor.bathroom_humidity
  above: 75
action:
- service: fan.turn_on
  target:
    entity_id: fan.bathroom_exhaust

alias: Start robot vacuum when Jordan leaves
rule:
id: L2_r07
alias: Start robot vacuum when Jordan leaves
trigger:
- platform: state
  entity_id: person.jordan
  to: not_home
action:
- service: vacuum.start
  target:
    entity_id: vacuum.robot

alias: Lock the door when Jordan leaves
rule:
id: L2_r08
alias: Lock the door when Jordan leaves
trigger:
- platform: state
  entity_id: person.jordan
  to: not_home
action:
- service: lock.lock
  target:
    entity_id: lock.front_door

id: L2_r09
alias: Close living blind at sunset
trigger:
- platform: sun
  event: sunset
action:
- service: cover.close_cover
  target:
    entity_id: cover.living_blind

alias: Turn living outlet off when Jordan leaves
rule:
id: L2_r10
alias: Turn living outlet off when Jordan leaves
trigger:
- platform: state
  entity_id: person.jordan
  to: not_home
action:
- service: switch.turn_off
  target:
    entity_id: switch.living_outlet

id: L2_r11
alias: Unlock door when Casey arrives
trigger:
- platform: state
  entity_id: person.casey
  to: home
action:
- service: lock.unlock
  target:
    entity_id: lock.front_door

alias: Play music in the living room when someone enters
rule:
id: L2_r12
alias: Play music in the living room when someone enters
trigger:
- platform: state
  entity_id: binary_sensor.living_motion
  to: 'on'
action:
- service: media_player.play_media
  target:
    entity_id: media_player.living_speaker
  data:
    media_content_id: playlist
    media_content_type: music
